explanation: Matches the odd case of Conjecture 1.6 in Cho–Choi–Park (arXiv 2107.00295): i(G) <= (D^2+3)/((D+1)(D+3)) |V(G)|, cleared of denominators, with isolate-free G. It also agrees with Cho–Kim–Kim–Oum (arXiv 2202.09594) Corollary 1.3, since floor((D+2)^2/4) = (D+1)(D+3)/4 for odd D, so the `research solved` tag is supported. Faithful.
